about_the_game:
The year is 6123. New quantum particle element compounds have been discovered in the asteroid belts of nearby star systems. The race has begun to establish a frontier mining operation. You and your crew have been hired by Hex Corp to collect the ARX crystals embedded in rocks.

Hex Corp is not the only Company in the stars though. There are other Mega Corporations competing for the opportunity to gather ARX for its potential to further increase their revenue. ARX is highly sought after for its extreme versatility.

GAMEPLAY

A turned based Sci-fi space ship combat game. Manage your crew, build your ship, upgrade your components,  mine and collect rocks and debris. Tactically configure your ship, man your stations, prepare for combat.

Hexarx features vessel warfare. You don’t just control the units you pilot the ship. You must manage your crew to man the ship systems accordingly. The ship can be expanded upgraded by the crew to add more weapons, utilities and accommodations for more crew members.
Individual crew members are class based and have different abilities that help when they man the systems so you need to outfit your ship with the right personnel.

short_description: HEXARX is a tactical turn based, crew management, ship building space combat game! You and your crew have been contracted by the Mega Corporations of New Hexaria Galaxy. Build, configure, upgrade and modify your ship. Manage and equip your crew members. Man your stations and protect your claim.
